targets.outcome_quote: In this replication study, we failed to find evidence that TMR strengthens the effects of counter-bias training, either immediately or after a 1-week delay. This decreases our confidence that TMR can be used to reduce implicit social biases.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict for targeted memory reactivation. Counter-bias training alone is not the central targeted finding.
